name: NVIDIA Dynamo
desc: Open-source distributed inference serving for multi-node GPU.
desc_zh: 面向多节点 GPU 的开源分布式推理服务框架
solves: A single GPU is fine until it is not. Dynamo splits prefill and decode across nodes, routes around redundant work, and caches KV to cheaper storage.
solves_zh: 单卡够用的时候没问题，不够用时就是了。Dynamo 把 prefill 和 decode 拆到不同节点，绕开重复计算，并把 KV 缓存到更便宜的存储。
best_for: You are serving LLMs across a multi-GPU cluster and prefill/decode is your bottleneck.
best_for_zh: 你在多卡集群上服务大模型，瓶颈卡在 prefill/decode 上。
